NeuS — Learning Neural Implicit Surfaces by Volume Rendering for Multi-view Reconstruction
definition: Designed a volume rendering technique for surface representation to improve geometric reconstruction quality.
summary: NeuS is a neural surface reconstruction method that represents surfaces as signed distance functions and trains them using a novel volume rendering scheme to avoid geometric bias.
